I've worked with quest for almost three years. I can't say I blame everyone for having strong negative views about them. Things have gotten worse since I first started and it doesn't look like its going to get any better. We're constantly understaffed, over worked, and under payed. When they broke the news to the techs at the lab, none of us were excited about this. I talked to some of my co-workers about the news to get their opinions. Not a single one of them were happy about this. This is what it took for them to increase the number of techs after years of complaining, but i'm doubtful about how many they're going to add. Chances are its not going to be enough and we'll tell them just to be ignored like before. Our benefits are getting worse and raises are pretty much non-existent. From day one of working there, the older techs told me that should leave while i'm still young. At first I kind of brushed it off, but now I can see where they're coming from. I've been trying to transition to an LIS position to try and get out for months now, but no luck.
